mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity, measured by housing starts, indicates a strengthening demand side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) grow faster than the consumer price index (CPI), it indicates real demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > CPIAUCSL growth in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when real PCE growth exceeds CPI growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease & PAYEMS increase in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of improving labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in real GDP signals a supportive monetary policy in a growing economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decrease & GDPC1 increase in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of easing monetary policy and GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase & UNRATE decrease in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of GDP growth and falling unemployment.
